leadText: Get The Flying Machine!! (Japanese: 空飛ぶマシーンを手に入れろ！！ Obtain the Flying Machine!!) is the sixteenth chapter of the Pokémon Pocket Monsters manga. It was first published in the July 1997 issue of CoroCoro Comic, on June 15th, 1997.
